info.name: Katibu API
info.description: Katibu Financial Management Platform API. All protected endpoints require Bearer token. Set {{base_url}} to http://localhost:8080 for local dev.

request.description: Register a new user account.
Authenticate and receive a JWT token.
Create a new project ledger. For CUSTOM durationType, provide endDate. For fixed types (WEEKLY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, HALF_YEARLY, YEARLY), endDate is auto-calculated.
List all projects where the authenticated user is creator or admin member.
Get a single project by ID.
Update project name and description. Only accessible to creator and admin members.
Archive a project. Only the project creator can archive. Archived projects are read-only.
List all admin members of a project (excludes creator).
Add a registered user as an admin member. Only the project creator can do this.
Remove an admin member from a project. Only the creator can remove members.
Add a ledger entry. Entry types: INITIAL_CAPITAL, DONATION, REVENUE, GRANT, LOAN_RECEIVED, CREDIT (inflows); PURCHASE, EXPENDITURE, LOAN_REPAYMENT, DEBT_PAYMENT, WITHDRAWAL (outflows).
List all non-deleted ledger entries for a project, ordered by transaction date descending.
Get a specific ledger entry.
Update an existing ledger entry. Not allowed for archived projects.
Soft-delete a ledger entry. The record is retained in the database for audit purposes.
Get a summary of total receipts, payments, and closing balance for the period.
Statement of Receipts and Payments per IPSAS 2 (cash basis). Groups all inflows as Receipts and outflows as Payments by type.
IFRS-aligned Cash Flow Statement categorised into Operating, Investing, and Financing activities.

exec: pm.test('Net cash flow = operating + investing + financing', () => {

request.description: Statement of Financial Position (balance sheet equivalent) as at a specific date. Shows assets (cash), liabilities (loans/debts), and net assets.
General Ledger with DR/CR entries and running balance. Inflows = Debit (cash received), Outflows = Credit (cash paid).
Trial Balance as at a date. Shows DR/CR balances per account. Total debits should equal total credits.
Balance Sheet as at a date. Assets = Liabilities + Equity. Shows cash assets, outstanding liabilities, contributed capital and retained surplus.
Generate a shareable public link for this project's reports. Optional expiresAt (ISO 8601 datetime). The link does not require authentication.
List all public links for a project, including revoked ones.
Revoke (deactivate) a public link. It will no longer be accessible.
Resolve a public token and return the project name. Used by the public report view to display the project name in the header before any report is run.
Access summary report via a public token. No authentication required.
Access receipts and payments report via public token.
Access cash flow statement via public token.
Access financial position report via public token.
Access general ledger via public token.
Access trial balance via public token.
Access balance sheet via public token.
Generate and store a PDF report. reportType options: SUMMARY, RECEIPTS_PAYMENTS, CASH_FLOW, FINANCIAL_POSITION, LEDGER. fileType: PDF or CSV.
Export full ledger as CSV.
List all generated files for a project.
Download a generated file. Response is the raw file (PDF or CSV) with Content-Disposition attachment header.
Get the authenticated user's profile (id, email, fullName, createdAt).
Update the authenticated user's full name and/or email address.
Change password. Requires current password for verification. New password must be at least 8 characters.
